title: Second specific day: 1600m D+, descent capped 1200m
terrain: alpine, 1600m D+ over 20-22km, D- hard-capped 1200m, point-to-point or lift-assisted finish

steps.target: Z2-Z3 first sustained climb, ~900m D+, 84-89% LTHR

coachNotes: CUT 235 -> 195, D+ 2000 -> 1600, D- cap 1500 -> 1200, on 21 August. This is the other half of the trade that made 22 August bigger. Load placed 21 days out is cheap and load placed 7 days out is expensive, and the version of this plan that put the biggest single day here was betting the taper on a session that had no week behind it to absorb. Start-line numbers barely move: CTL 44.0 against a 42 target, TSB +7.6 rather than +5.9, so the rebalance costs 0.4 fitness points and buys 1.7 points of freshness. THE PRECONDITION IS GONE, WHICH IS THE REAL POINT. The 2000m version required real eccentric work through week 7 in Milan and Belgium to be safe, and travel weeks eat that kind of promise. At 1600m D+ / 1200m D- this session sits below 22 August's 1400m of descent, so the eccentric ramp across the 14-day flat gap is negative rather than positive. Do the week 7 work anyway, it makes this day better, but the plan no longer breaks if you miss it. DESCENT CAP 1200m, STILL NOT NEGOTIABLE. Point-to-point finishing ~400m above the start, or take a lift down the last section. If the only option is a loop with matched D-, the day becomes 1300m D+ / 1300m D-: the descent cap outranks the climb target, every time. THE CAP IS THE ROUTE, NOT YOUR DISCIPLINE. Fixed line, fixed endpoint, load the GPX. No extensions, no summit out-and-backs. Finishing strong is the session working, not an invitation. WHAT THIS BUYS: 48% of race vertical at roughly race gradient, ~4h20 on your feet, the second fuelling rehearsal seven days out, and the knowledge that the legs come back from 22 August. It is not fitness. CTL is already past target and one session cannot move it. FUELLING: full race kit, nothing new, 60-90g carbs per hour from minute 40. Compare against what you wrote down on 22 August and fix whatever went wrong then. AMBER: HRV 7d/28d under 0.90 or any lateral knee signal on Thursday or Friday means one climb and out, ~900m D+, load 130. Garmin expect 320-380.
